data.name: Perfume Atelier
data.detailed_description:
✨ Get it Together Discounted!


About the Game

Step into your own little perfume workshop, where every bottle tells a story. 🌸 Mix fragrant essences, design beautiful bottles, and share your creations with curious customers who are searching for scents that match their mood. As your atelier grows, decorate your space, unlock new recipes, and build your reputation in the gentle art of fragrance.

✨ Cozy Crafting

Choose from a wide library of essences, each with its own traits. Mix and match to create perfumes that carry distinct moods, accords, and tones. Every drop counts, so use your ingredients wisely.

🎨 Bottle Design

Express yourself through bottle shapes, caps, labels, and colors. There’s no wrong way to design, each creation is uniquely yours.

🛍️ Shopkeeping

Welcome curious customers with their own requests and quirks. Wrap bottles, prepare testers, and match perfumes to their tastes. Build a reputation for thoughtfulness and creativity.

🌿 Progression & Discovery

Unlock new essences, recipes, and decorative elements as you grow. Meet the mysterious traveling merchant, take on special orders, and collect rare labels for your perfumes.

Will your atelier become a treasured stop in the neighborhood, known for perfumes that match not just a scent, but a feeling?

💖 If you’d like to support the game, don’t forget to add Perfume Atelier to your Wishlist!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 or later
  • Processor: Intel Pentium CPU G860
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 840M
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 64 Bit Only
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.6 or above
  • Processor: Apple Silicon M1 (M2 and M3) or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1280x720 minimum resolution, OpenGL 2.0 Support, and recommended dedicated graphics card with 128 MB of RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: M1, M2, M3 Silicon Mac & ARM Supported

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04, SteamOS (Proton-8 Recommended)
  • Processor: 1.7 GHz Processor
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8 or higher, ATI X1600 or higher, or Intel HD 3000 or higher
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: Proton-8 Recommended
